title: cz-osc~
description: `cz-osc~` emulates the oscillators of the Casio CZ series and offers selectable waveforms such as saw, square, pulse, sinepulse, halfsine, and resonant variants. Like `cos~`, it is driven by a `phasor~`; its optional first argument selects the oscillator waveform, which can also be changed using floats or symbols.
